body: The section that defines them says: "The following exception names are defined by WebIDL" I found that some of them, including RangeError are actually defined in ECMA-262. Not a big deal I think since WebIDL kind of "forward declares" them. Just wanted to point that out because I think saying they are "defined by WebIDL" is not technically correct.
